YUVARAJ RAVI 
Chennai, India | Phone: +91 9704818090 | Email: yuvaraj07ravi@gmail.com 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Results-driven Trade Processing & Custody Operations Professional with over 8 years of 
experience in Investment Banking Operations, Securities Settlement, Cash Processing, 
and Reconciliation. Expert in SWIFT messaging (MT54X, MT103, MT202, MT599), 
Middle Office operations, and global market settlements. Proven leader in process 
improvement using Agile project management practices, including Sprint Planning and 
User Story documentation. Recognized for high accuracy, SLA compliance, and client 
satisfaction in high-volume, deadline-driven environments. 
 
CORE SKILLS & KEYWORDS 
• Operations: Trade Processing, Securities Settlement, Custody Operations, Middle 
Office Operations. 
• Cash Management: Cash & Position Reconciliation, Break Investigation & 
Resolution, Exception Management. 
• Messaging & Funding: SWIFT (MT540–MT548, MT103, MT202, MT599), 
Funding & Repatriation (DVP/RVP), FX Processing. 
• Compliance: Corporate Actions Support, Client Servicing, Audit Support, MIS 
Reporting, Risk & Compliance, SLA & TAT Management. 
• Agile Project Management: Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, User Story 
Documentation, UAT & SIT Coordination, Process Improvement, Stakeholder 
Management. 
• Systems & Tools: TCS BaNCS, Smart-Stream TLM, TM, SECCURE. 
• Global Markets: Middle East Markets, DTC, Canada, FED, Bahrain Bourse, 
Tadawul EDAA. 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Standard Chartered Bank GBS | Team Leader, Custody Operations & Trade 
Processing 
 
Jan 2024 – Present | Chennai 
 
• Lead Custody Operations and Trade Processing for Middle East markets, 
overseeing securities settlement and pre-matching. 
• Execute trade capture and instruction amendments (MT540–MT543) while 
validating client instructions against SWIFT standards. 
• Manage the end-to-end settlement lifecycle using TCS BaNCS, including repair, 
release, and confirmation (MT544–MT548). 
• Perform funding and repatriation for DVP/RVP trades utilizing MT103/MT202 
messages and internal transfers. 
• Conduct daily cash and trade reconciliations, investigating breaks and resolving 
exceptions within defined SLAs. 
• Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning and Daily Scrum meetings, to 
track system enhancements. 
• Develop User Stories and functional requirements to drive automation and 
workflow optimization. 
• Coordinate UAT, UVT, and SIT testing for new system releases to ensure seamless 
production deployment. 
• Collaborate with external counterparties, such as HSBC, for payment processing and 
trade matching. 
• Maintain strict adherence to Departmental Operating Instructions (DOI), risk 
controls, and audit standards. 
 
State Street HCL Services | Specialist / SME, Trade & Cash Operations 
 
Jul 2018 – Oct 2023 | Chennai 
 
• Directed transaction services for trade processing and securities settlement through 
MT54X manual processing and broker confirmations. 
• Key contributor to process migration and knowledge transition, ensuring zero 
business disruption during onshore-to-offshore moves. 
• Championed automation and transformation initiatives to reduce manual 
intervention in reconciliation workflows. 
• Supported change management by documenting SOPs and training team members 
on new system enhancements. 
• Participated in Agile-driven operational transformation projects through Sprint 
Planning and Daily Scrum meetings. 
• Drafted User Stories and functional documentation for reconciliation process 
improvements. 
• Managed hyper-care client operations, including pre-funding and MT599 
messaging support during transition phases. 
• Processed same-day settlement transactions for DTC, Canada, and FED markets, 
including Repo and Reverse Repo trades. 
• Executed cash instructions (MT103, MT202, MT202COV) and ensured accurate 
SSI validation. 
• Utilized SmartStream TLM for daily reconciliation, performing root cause analysis 
on failed trades and settlement breaks. 
• Produced MIS reports and reconciliation dashboards to update senior management 
on transformation progress. 
• Partnered with Reference Data and Technology teams to support system migration 
and automation delivery. 
 
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS & AWARDS 
• Achievers League Trophy: Received for four consecutive years (2019–2022) for top 
performance and consistent SLA delivery. 
• Client Appreciation: Honored for maintaining high settlement accuracy and 
delivering issue-free operations.
